units.rawText: Are you looking at my high heels, Professor? Hehe, yours truly had no idea you were so interested in them.

units.rawText: High heels are an office lady's finest weapon. Working women wear them every day and fight with elegant poise, whether in the office or on the battlefield. Still, after wearing them for a long time, it does get a little tiring...
